title: add vpc control plane terraform + private-installer: multi-az subnets, interface endpoints, sgs, peering, route53
author: Asha Patel
description: Adds Terraform modules and installer hooks to provision VPC Private Control Plane resources for multi-AZ Redwood Private deployments. Includes multi-AZ subnets, interface endpoints (S3, STS, ECR, KMS), security groups tuned for control-plane traffic, cross-account VPC peering automation, and Route53 inbound/outbound zone delegation with DNS propagation checks. Also updates the private Helm chart values for endpoint configuration, adds installer preflight/post-install upgrade and rollback hooks, and includes integration tests and docs. Motivation: enable fully automated provisioning and lifecycle management of network resources required for private control plane in customer VPCs and on-prem air-gapped variants while providing safe upgrade/rollback semantics. Checklist: - [x] Terraform module implemented and documented - [x] Installer pre/post hooks added - [x] Helm chart values and chart bump - [x] Integration tests and perf-canary runs - [x] Linear ENG-3421 referenced - [ ] e2e run in production-stage (follow-up). Testing notes: tested terraform plan/apply in staging account with state import; validated peering, route53 delegation, and interface endpoint routing across AZs; ran installer smoke tests and simulated upgrade+rollback flips; performed canary deploys in perf-canary to validate latency/throughput impacts. Rollback/upgrade safety: installer hooks are idempotent, peering changes are gated behind canary flag, DNS changes are applied with commit timestamps and optional dry-run; rollback removes peering and restores previous Route53 delegation when triggered. Operator guidance: see docs/private/vpc-control-plane.md for required IAM roles and preflight checklist before running the installer. Release notes: Adds automated VPC control plane provisioning via Terraform and installer hooks; no automatic changes to existing customer VPCs unless operator runs installer/terraform apply. Follow-up: schedule e2e in production-stage and add cross-account peering policy templates for partner customers.
